OxiCloud cache_header.hurl fixture — content unique to this scenario.

This file exists so the X-Oxicloud-Cache MISS → HIT transition pinned by
tests/api/cache_header.hurl is honest. The moka file-content cache is
content-addressed (keyed by BLAKE3 of the body), so a scenario reusing
fixtures that other scenarios touch (hello.txt, dedup-test.jpg,
red-image.png, …) would see HIT on its very first read because an
earlier scenario in the same run already warmed the hash.

Keeping these bytes exclusive to cache_header.hurl means the first GET
after upload is guaranteed to be a MISS. Do NOT reuse this file in
other scenarios. If a diff ever brings in another consumer of this
fixture, split the content so the hashes diverge.

Random tag so a casual grep catches accidental reuse:
    cache-header-fixture-id: 9d1e7a3f-2b48-4b70-9b45-a3cc19a4f9e4
